spoken: [hook] You don't have a motivation problem. || You have a size problem. Your first step is just too big. || Like, write a book. Nobody can start that on a Tuesday night. || [turn] So shrink it. Write three sentences of chapter one, tonight. That's it. || Same with get fit. Don't plan the whole program, just put your shoes by the door. || [land] Here's the rule. If the first step takes more than ten minutes, shrink it again. || [outro] That's the idea Dmyor is built around. || [outro] And if you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
tagline:
Shrink the first step.
Then take it.
